mapper.sql: id::text AS id, user_id, source_memory_ids::text AS source_memory_ids_json, source_fingerprint, proposed_type, proposed_content, status, applied_memory_id::text AS applied_memory_id, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_memory_consolidation_proposal (user_id, source_memory_ids, source_fingerprint, proposed_type, proposed_content, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, CAST(#{sourceMemoryIdsJson} AS jsonb), #{sourceFingerprint}, #{proposedType}, #{proposedContent}, 'PENDING', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_memory_consolidation_proposal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM user_memory_consolidation_proposal WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE user_memory_consolidation_proposal SET status = #{status}, applied_memory_id = CASE WHEN CAST(#{appliedMemoryId} AS uuid) IS NULL THEN applied_memory_id ELSE CAST(#{appliedMemoryId} AS uuid) END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING'
